title: Kristy G NDE 5366
content: I was a passenger in a car and we were hit head-on by another vehicle. I remember seeing its headlights coming towards us. I was talking on the phone with my mom at the time and we were arguing about something. I just felt really still for a minute, then I saw a long dark tunnel with a light at the end and I walked through it. I saw my body in the car and felt my sister tug on my hair saying, ‘Kristy, don't leave me. I need you.’ So, I returned. I did not want to leave. I went back into my body and my eyes did not feel like my eyes any more, they felt ‘different’ (I have been legally blind since birth). I went to the emergency room and just wanted to sleep. The doctor said I had a mild concussion and a broken collar bone.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' I was in a terrible car accident. I felt that I was there, but I was not. It felt like it lasted for hours but it only lasted for a few minutes.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Darkness | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Life review | Vision of the future
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: When I was nodding my head to go to sleep, after the car hit us.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning It felt like I was gone for hours but I was only gone for a few minutes.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I am legally blind but could see things, like bright flashing lights.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes It was very long and dark, I walked through it and then I saw a bright white light.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I remember seeing them in front of a gate. I knew them. They gave me a choice.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm it was in a big igland and it was very sunny and warm. very beautiful.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future Sometimes, I can see a picture and know more about it. I can sense things before they happen.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes I felt like I was given a choice. I came back for a purpose.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I have helped my family.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I have helped my family. After the NDE
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I see ghosts and assist them with crossing over. I can also do psychic readings.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: It was very educational and it helped me to see a part of myself I did not know I had. Now I help others.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes A year later. They were impressed. I gave messages to people from the other side, which gave them peace.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real It feels really good to do something nice for others without wanting anything back.
